ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left of the figure is a benzene ring, and the aryl carbon at the upper right is connected to a Li label; two adjacent positions on the left side of the benzene ring each have a methoxy substituent (CH3O/OC). The lower right of the benzene ring is connected through a benzylic CH2 to the N atom of a five-membered nitrogen-containing aromatic ring. The carbon adjacent to N on this five-membered ring is connected to a carbonyl amide group, and the carbonyl carbon is connected to O and also connected to Et2N (diethylamino). There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: According to the specified method, starting from the aryl carbon connected to Li, write [Li]c1, traverse along the benzene ring and add two methoxy branches (OC) at two adjacent aryl positions to obtain [Li]c1cc(OC)c(OC)cc1. Then attach benzylic C at the benzene ring closure position, and connect this carbon to the N of the five-membered aromatic nitrogen-containing ring, written as Cn1cccc1. Finally attach the carbonyl diethylamide branch C(=O)N(CC)CC to the adjacent carbon on this heteroaromatic ring. Combining gives SMILES: [Li]c1cc(OC)c(OC)cc1Cn1cccc1C(=O)N(CC)CC.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Read the molecular graph directly from the image, not the electron-flow arrows. Start the SMILES at the aryl carbon bonded to Li as [Li]c1, traverse the benzene ring while adding the two methoxy branches as (OC) at the correct adjacent aryl positions, then close the benzene ring and append the benzylic linker C. From that carbon, enter the N atom of the five-membered aromatic ring as n1cccc1, placing the carbonyl diethylamide branch on the ring carbon shown adjacent to the heteroaromatic ring. Combine these fragments to obtain [Li]c1cc(OC)c(OC)cc1Cn1cccc1C(=O)N(CC)CC.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个苯环，右上方的芳基碳与 Li 标注相连，苯环左侧相邻两个位置各有一个甲氧基取代基（CH3O/OC）。苯环右下方通过一个苄基 CH2 连接到一个五元含氮芳香环的 N 原子。该五元环上与 N 相邻的碳连有一个羰基酰胺基，羰基碳连接 O，同时连接 Et2N（二乙基氨基）。图中还有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：按照指定方法，从与 Li 相连的芳基碳开始写作 [Li]c1，沿苯环遍历并在相邻两个芳基位置加入两个甲氧基支链 (OC)，得到 [Li]c1cc(OC)c(OC)cc1。随后在苯环闭合位置接苄基 C，并由该碳连接到五元芳香含氮环 N，写作 Cn1cccc1。最后在该杂芳环相邻碳上接羰基二乙基酰胺支链 C(=O)N(CC)CC。合并得到 SMILES：[Li]c1cc(OC)c(OC)cc1Cn1cccc1C(=O)N(CC)CC。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the straightforward structure-to-SMILES transcription route; the task is effectively single-solution because the drawing specifies one connectivity pattern once the curved arrows are ignored.
planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the drawing as a chemical structure: identify a substituted benzene ring bearing two methoxy groups on adjacent left-side positions, a lithium attached to one aryl carbon, and a benzylic CH2 connection to an N-containing five-membered aromatic ring; identify that this heteroaromatic ring also bears a carbonyl substituent connected to a diethylamide group. Ignore all curved arrows and arrowheads visually present.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored, so only atom connectivity from the drawing is encoded.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply standard SMILES rules: use aromatic lowercase atoms for benzene and pyrrole-like ring atoms, encode methoxy as OC branches, encode lithium bonded to aromatic carbon as [Li]c, encode the N-substituted five-membered aromatic ring as n1cccc1 when the benzylic group is attached to nitrogen, and encode the amide as C(=O)N(CC)CC.
